verdict.rationale: Clara documents a REST API for retrieving and reconciling transactions, with date-range and user filters and a probe-confirmed OpenAPI schema, so the transaction-pull core is clearly delivered. Credentials are self-managed per project from the dashboard and expire, but the evidence never states OAuth or scoped tokens. Expense and receipt endpoints are not documented. missing for 10: receipt retrieval endpoints, expense/expense-report API endpoints, explicit OAuth flow, scoped token permissions, independent hands-on corroboration.
